arms.D: stock Cargo and stock Rust release

conditions: 12 blocks on a separate host, selected before observing H4 effects. No changes to the H4 population, plan, or qualification. Each slot starts with verifiably independent empty targets and build stores. Refuse to score if an exact process, output, dirty roster, BLAKE3 proof, functional probe, hardware or source gate fails. Never discard/reorder slow rows. Stop before scoring an arm if the small release or full-workspace traced proof fails. Do not rerun a failed slot in place. Candidate cold/first/settled must preserve all 110 raw bytes, both arms must match an independent same-arm qualification reference outside the physically proven 0↔N .rodata sh_entsize and its changed 32-byte GNU build ID, only for non-writable, non-executable, allocated mergeable PROGBITS .rodata and N in {1,2,4,8,16,32,64,128,256}. The ELF helper and all 36 original stock-only fixture executions match the independent H4 revised control under b958edb54d0bc8528b690a6867f2113b790292e9. Every other byte must match, including size, ELF section type and flags. Nonzero-to-nonzero or same-width ID-only divergence fails; candidate within each triplet stays completely byte-identical. Cold, first and settled are real native command intervals, and use the same post-command checks defined by H4.
environment: No local registry procedural-macro or native-tool trust opt-ins. No strace, compiler wrappers, fingerprint logger, PMU, added user rustc flags, or running tests in a timed command. Input registry files are available offline. Cold refers to initially empty target and shared build stores, not an empty kernel page cache. Every arm uses the same frozen logical source, toolchain, target, shared, registry, jobs and affinity, on the same private ext4 device.
host: charlie-ohm-loader-perf-1024 H5, 32 logical AMD EPYC Milan cores, same kernel and j8, 0–23. All new targets, builds and registry caches reside on the same private ext4 device. The common read-only checkout and frozen runtime use their original H5 canonical paths.
inference: Report both predeclared D:C primary outcomes and numerical safety thresholds from this host. This independent newer trial neither overrides its first stopped enrollment nor any H4 marginal outcome.
measurement: A slot has three consecutive native Cargo subprocesses, each timed with monotonic_ns. Identical out-of-timer output hashing and correctness checks follow each command, including between cold and first. The combined endpoint sums the two command durations and excludes these audits. No source or flags change between commands. The ELF checks scan the same roster in each arm. The single fixed ordinary stdlib test and CLI oracles execute only after all timed commands.

previous_stop.disposition: The previous first stock-only slot stopped, with no accepted timing rows. This enrollment uses newly initialized private native references and slots; the previous study contributes zero observations.

primary: C vs D on the first unchanged command and cold+first sum using the geometric mean of paired ratios. Two-sided exact randomization over the 924 allocations with 6 candidate-late assignments among 12 blocks. Holm over both endpoints at 0.05, and 95% paired bootstrap lower reduction above zero. Report both command medians, estimated ratios, intervals, and exact P values.
relation: This independently tests the cohesive stock-to-candidate improvement. It cannot salvage an H4 conditional ablation that fails its own release-specific thresholds. Report all results even if a floor fails.
safety: The paired one-sided 98.75% bootstrap upper cold overhead must be below 3%, and the 98.75% upper settled overhead must be below both 5% and 100ms. All bootstrap intervals use 20,000 block resamples. Separately report first and settled physical dispatches from both unscored traced arms and runtime controls.
state_root: ron-first-replication-ffield-v2. Its dedicated target, shared registry/build, results and CSV exist only in the new scope, with the same canonical logical paths inside each job. Only checksum-verified compiler/Cargo/BLAKE3 inputs from the frozen H5 installation are reused.
storage: Require free 25GiB on scratch and HOME and another 16GiB on scratch before creating the next slot. Keep complete private qualification states. Retire completed scored states only after stock/current product hashes, all native output hashes, per-arm oracle, actual input hashes, receipt BLAKE3 and CSV are durably validated.
study: independent cold RON replication on a different host
